rules.description: TLS/HTTPS required vs optional or cleartext allowed must align between canonical and row
rules.messageTemplate: TLS or HTTPS requirement contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Align transport encryption requirements with the canonical TLS policy.

rules.description: Minimum TLS version stated in the row must match the floor in the canonical answer
rules.messageTemplate: Minimum TLS version in the row does not match the canonical TLS floor
rules.resolutionGuidance: State the same minimum TLS version (e.g. 1.2 vs 1.3) as the canonical policy.

rules.description: Row must not advertise deprecated TLS/SSL versions when describing customer-facing transport
rules.messageTemplate: Row references weak or deprecated TLS/SSL versions
rules.resolutionGuidance: Remove weak protocol language and align with modern TLS baselines in the canonical answer.

rules.description: Internal or east-west encryption stance (mTLS/mesh vs cleartext internal) must align
rules.messageTemplate: Inter-service encryption assertion contradicts the approved canonical answer
rules.resolutionGuidance: Match mTLS, mesh, or internal TLS claims to the canonical inter-service policy.

rules.description: When canonical requires mTLS or mesh for internal traffic, the row should mention it
rules.messageTemplate: Canonical requires internal transport protection but the row does not mention mTLS/mesh or equivalent
rules.resolutionGuidance: Describe internal encryption the same way as the canonical answer (mTLS, mesh, etc.).
